bioconda.name: losat
bioconda.summary: BLAST-compatible local sequence alignment tool implemented in Rust
bioconda.description:
LOSAT is a Rust implementation of BLAST-compatible local sequence alignment
focused on certified local query/subject profiles for BLASTN, BLASTP, and
TBLASTX. NCBI BLAST+ is a validation oracle only and is not a LOSAT runtime
or build dependency.
